ai_summary: ABM Knowledgeware Limited reported mixed unaudited results for Q2 and H1 FY27, showcasing healthy growth in revenue from operations both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year. However, this positive top-line performance was significantly overshadowed by a substantial surge in operating expenses and a notable reduction in other income. Consequently, Profit Before Tax (PBT) experienced a material decline, dropping by nearly 70% quarter-on-quarter and 25% year-on-year for the latest quarter, indicating a significant red flag regarding cost control and profitability despite revenue expansion.
